title: Introduce query-hint service and alert-playbook-generator for telemetry debugging
author: Nora Liu
description:
Problem: Customers and SREs frequently need fast, contextual recommendations for query refinements and an operational playbook when an alert fires. Investigating token-level latency/cost spikes currently requires manual querying across traces, metrics, and slow ad-hoc runbooks.

Goal: Add a small, low-latency service that produces query hints (time/range filters, high-value labels, suggested aggregation windows) for common telemetry queries and synthesize a short, actionable alert playbook when a route/tenant crosses cost or latency thresholds. The service should be non-blocking, cached, and pluggable into the observability UI and CLI.

This PR implements: 1) telemetry/query-hint service that inspects recent metrics/traces and returns ranked hints for faster investigation; 2) alert-playbook-generator that maps common SLO breach patterns to a short checklist and recommended dashboard links; 3) UI panel and API endpoints to surface hints and playbooks; 4) small automation that attaches playbook snippets to newly created PagerDuty incidents.

Design notes: - Query-hint is heuristic-first (entropy and recent variance detectors) and uses a short rolling window (5m / 1h) to avoid stale suggestions. - Playbook rules are YAML-driven (configs under observability/playbooks/) so on-call can iterate without code changes. - All outputs include a provenance token to correlate hint->trace origin for audit/debugging.

Testing and rollout: - Feature gated behind observability.experimental.query_hints (off by default). - Integration tests run against the observability e2e harness. - Step rollout: internal canary -> beta tenants -> GA.

Checklist:
- [x] Implementation of hint engine and playbook generator
- [x] API + lightweight HTTP handler with auth checks
- [x] UI panel JSON and client wiring in observability console
- [x] Unit + integration tests (e2e)
- [x] Documentation: docs/observability/query-hints.md and playbook author guide
- [x] CI green and manual canary validation

Related: Linear ENG-2389 (query-hint engine), ENG-2390 (alert playbooks), internal runbook RFC: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2350/observability-playbook-rfc

merge_details: Merged by squash on 2025-09-03 by Nora Liu. Merge commit: 9a3f2b4. Release notes entry added under observability/release-notes/2025-09-03.md. Rollout notes: start internal canary group (100 tenants), evaluate signal quality for 48h before expanding to beta.
release_notes: Added telemetry query-hints service and alert-playbook-generator. Feature off-by-default behind experimental flag. Provides ranked query suggestions and one-page playbooks for common SLO breach patterns. See docs/observability/query-hints.md for usage and playbook authoring.
notes_for_oncall: If an alert surfaces a generated playbook, the playbook will include a provenance token. Use /observability/query-hints?provenance=<token> to get the originating hints and traces. If hints appear noisy, disable observability.experimental.query_hints for the tenant and file ENG-2390.
security_considerations: Playbooks and hints may contain tenant identifiers; outputs are scrubbed to PII policy and the endpoint enforces tenant-scoped auth. PagerDuty attachments only include playbook snippets (no raw traces).
rollback_plan: Toggle observability.experimental.query_hints=false to disable hint generation immediately. Revert deployment if PagerDuty attachments are misbehaving. Archived playbook configs are preserved in observability/playbooks/disabled/.
manual_verification_steps: 1) Enable feature flag for a test tenant. 2) Trigger synthetic SLO breach (use telemetry/test-harness). 3) Confirm hint panel shows 3 ranked suggestions and playbook link in console. 4) Verify PagerDuty incident includes playbook snippet. 5) Run e2e test suite: make target e2e-query-hints.
